Good hot pot meal
Jun 2025 • Family
I highly recommend this restaurant if looking for meals either with family or friends while staying in Sapa. We ordered the mixed meat hot pot and grilled sturgeon fish, both were deliciously good. The lady explained what the soup was made of and gave a little to each of us to check if just right for our taste. She even cooked the food for us. She was on standby checking if we need more or any help, ready to assist. I can say during our stay in Sapa this was the best meal we had. Try it and you will never regret.
